angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 3,297,863 km at 147.85 pc = 0.3 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.7637 +/- 0.0270 mas (same row, RUWE 0.94): 147.85 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 4.740 (4.644 to 4.837) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 3,297,863 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.142 (1.091 to 1.199) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4799 +/- 9.4 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 2667434008056899712: teff_gspphot 4799.426 K (16th-84th percentiles 4784.3706-4803.166), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 2667434008056899712: teff_gspphot 4799.426 K (16th-84th percentiles 4784.3706-4803.166), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/bosona.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 3.144, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 206610 (pscomppars): spectral type K0 III, from Michigan Catalog, Vol. 5 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1999mctd.book.....H/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 206610 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.14 dex, from Johnson et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010PASP..122..701J/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 206610 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 1.27646, from Johnson et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010PASP..122..701J/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 206610 (pscomppars): age 3 Gyr, from Johnson et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010PASP..122..701J/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 206610 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.77 km/s, from Jofré et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015A&A...574A..50J/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
